'''Delaney''' (Japanese: '''ヤスジ''' ''Yasuji'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP247|Outrageous Fortunes]]''.

Delaney was on a winning streak and became increasingly arrogant as a result. He defeated {{OBP|Mason|EP247}} and later {{an|Misty}} in {{pkmn|battle}}s to earn himself his seventh and eighth consecutive victories. {{Ash}} was his next opponent, though {{an|Brock}} ordered the match to end in a draw to avoid overextending the Pokémon. Delaney was irritated at first, but he admitted that Ash and his {{AP|Bayleef}} put up a good fight.

Later, Delaney was approached by [[Jessie]], who [[List of Team Rocket's disguises|posed as a successful fortune teller]]. He was skeptical at first, but after hearing [[James]] and {{MTR}}'s fake recommendation, he decided to hear her out. Jessie looked into her crystal ball and suggested Delaney's {{p|Poliwrath}} was possessed by evil and offered to help cleanse Poliwrath, Delaney accepting her offer. By the time he realized the fortune-telling stall was a scam, it was too late, and Team Rocket had already escaped with Poliwrath.

His shouts alerted Ash and {{ashfr}}, and together, they chased down the trio. [[Misty's Corsola]] helped free Poliwrath from Team Rocket's control device. Afterwards, Poliwrath defeated Team Rocket alongside Misty's newly evolved {{TP|Misty|Politoed}}, as well as [[Ash's Phanpy]] and {{AP|Pikachu}}.
